dedupe_keys.name: servicio wms web map service presas

description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Presas is a dataset listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. The Web Service of Maps called Dams shows the data set called Inventory of Dams of the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge of Spain. This service allows the analysis and consultation of Dams throughout Spain regardless of ownership. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Service (Web Map Service) Dams" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
